scope: Rules-based V2 critic for impact pulse core reads.

detection_rules: HeroImpactBurst emitter is missing or under-authored.
Impact burst is not visually distinct from support layers.
hero_sweep_missing.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hero-layer failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: HeroImpactBurst does not establish a readable burst path around the impact core.
no_outside_to_core_read.escalation_rule: Two consecutive failures force a rebuild.

detection_rules: Hero or support layers read as an orbiting ring shell around the impact core.
orbit_ring_shell.escalation_rule: Repeated ring-shell reads force a hero rebuild.

detection_rules: HeroImpactBurst is rendered as thin ribbon lines instead of a readable impact streak mass.
thin_wireframe_ribbons.escalation_rule: Two consecutive hits force a hero rebuild.

secondary_overwhelms_hero.escalation_rule: Reduce support streaks before touching the hero burst.

detection_rules: The overall effect lingers as an orb shell instead of reading as a tight impact pulse.
lingering_orb_shell.escalation_rule: Tighten the pulse and glow before increasing brightness.

detection_rules: CoreImpactFlash or BindGlow reads as soft ambient glow instead of a compact impact center.
soft_ambient_glow.escalation_rule: Reduce ambient haze before polishing support sparks.
